GROUND RULES — CHECK ALL FOUR
All shuttles need the pre-booked follower pass
(France/Italy/Switzerland zones). Passes are bought.
Roads/parking CLOSED to private cars at Les Contamines, Courmayeur,
Champex,Trient, Vallorcine — the bus is the only way in.
No UTMB shuttle ever runs Chamonix →Les Houches.The car in
Chamonix is the only night ride home.
Phones: offline maps of the valley downloaded; power banks charged;
this PDF saved to phone.
Accuracy: All bus times from the official UTMB follower timetable (French poster, transcribed & verified). Corrected vs our earlier infographic:
NDG→Chamonix ride is 55 min (not 20).
